description: The XmlSerializer class provides serialization and deserialization of Java objects to and from XML format, supporting standard Java types, collections, maps, SQL date/time objects, and custom serializable objects. It is part of the Apache OFBiz framework, specifically within the entity serialization package.

classes.name: XmlSerializer
classes.description: A utility class for serializing and deserializing Java objects to and from XML format within the OFBiz framework. Deprecated in favor of UtilXml methods.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a Java object into an XML string, wrapping it in a root element 'ofbiz-ser'.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a Java object from an XML string or DOM Document, with delegator context for PK and value creation.

methods.name: serializeSingle
methods.description: Serializes a single Java object into an XML Element, handling standard types, collections, maps, SQL date/time objects, and custom objects.

methods.name: deserializeSingle
methods.description: Deserializes an XML Element back into a Java object, supporting standard types, collections, maps, PKs, and custom objects.
